commits.author: Wim Deblauwe
commits.message:
Redirect htmx requests to the current page when the session has expired

HxRedirectToPageAuthenticationEntryPoint and HxRedirectToPageAccessDeniedHandler answer an htmx request that needs
authentication, or whose CSRF token went with the expired session, with HX-Redirect to the page it was made from
(HX-Current-URL, or the link itself for a boosted link). The browser then makes a normal navigation, the application's
own entry point asks the user to sign in, and the page is the request to return to; the htmx request is removed from
the request cache. Other requests and other denials go to the application's entry point and access denied handler.

The README's Spring Security section now says which classes are alternatives and which combine.

Closes #202

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.author: Wim Deblauwe
commits.message:
Escape non-ASCII characters in JSON header values

Tomcat drops a response header whose value holds a character outside
Latin-1, so an HX-Trigger event detail with e.g. "Łukasz" made the whole
header disappear. Enable JsonWriteFeature.ESCAPE_NON_ASCII on the mappers
that write HX-Trigger* and HX-Location, so the header values are pure
ASCII and htmx's JSON.parse restores the original characters.

Fixes #197

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.author: Wim Deblauwe
commits.message:
Keep the order of HX-Trigger events with details

Collect the triggers in a LinkedHashMap instead of a HashMap, so the
events in the JSON header fire in the order they were added.

Fixes #198
